cases.title: Selling a dream to a country of touring bikes.
cases.body: For over a year, I developed model-specific positioning and adapted Ducati’s international creative assets into campaigns for Germany across TV, social and retail.
cases.role: External creative & strategy consultant (via m&T Frankfurt)
cases.outcome: Cost per lead −43 %. Conversion rate +110 %. Brand film aired at MotoGP.
cases.challenge: In Germany, BMW Motorrad owns engineering and efficiency. Ducati owns something else: Italian passion with character — nothing smoothed out. Most Germans buy touring enduros, yet what draws them to Ducati is passion, Italian racing and design. The task: give each model a clear role in the German market, charge the brand emotionally, and convert that emotion into sales.
cases.insight: Riding a motorcycle makes no rational sense. It's pure emotion — as every rider knows the moment they come out of the supermarket and look for the boot.
cases.strategy: So for the whole year, I put one theme at the centre: the dream — the most essential reason anyone buys a motorcycle. Every model owns a different one.

models.name: Panigale V4
models.line: Brand flagship — the machine everyone dreams of and connects with Ducati

models.name: Multistrada V4
models.line: Touring riders — imagery of distance, open space and unforgettable experiences; the urge for freedom every enduro rider knows

models.name: XDiavel
models.line: Design-driven riders — Italian style as a statement

items: One TV spot per model — Multistrada V4, XDiavel, Panigale V4

steps: Model-specific positioning for three Ducati models in Germany
One theme for the year: the dream
Translated international footage and creative assets into locally relevant narratives and campaign executions for Germany
One TV spot per model, brand films for the Panigale V4
result: Cost per lead reduced by 43 %
Conversion rate up 110 %
Three model TVCs
Brand film aired at MotoGP, built from existing footage
Sales-focused executions across seasonal, financing and accessory campaigns
cases.footnote: Performance figures reflect the overall campaign, including tracking and media by Magni & Tude. My contribution: creative work and campaign positioning.

cases.slotHint: O₂ Record Race — Gran Turismo steering wheel
cases.title: A world record the gaming community set themselves.
cases.body: Instead of telling gamers O₂ belongs in their world, we gave them something to take part in: a world record attempt with PlayStation for the most laps completed in Gran Turismo 7 within 48 hours.
cases.outcome: All slots booked in 5 days. New world record.
cases.challenge: O₂ wanted credibility in gaming — a community that quickly spots brands that only borrow its culture. The task was to earn a place in it and create awareness beyond the event itself.
cases.idea: Don't sponsor the game. Let the community make history with it. Together with PlayStation, we staged a world record attempt for the most laps completed in Gran Turismo 7 within 48 hours, supported by a dedicated microsite, gaming creators and an integrated social campaign.
did: Built the campaign architecture connecting live event, microsite, gaming creators and social
Developed the creative concept and experience design
Art direction and key visual, including AI-generated artwork
result: All participant slots booked within 5 days
48 hours non-stop, 78 drivers, 1,143 team laps
New world record: most laps completed in Gran Turismo 7 within 48 hours

cases.slotHint: [Image showing BMW 2002 and 2 Series Coupé together, if available]
cases.title: A car built for America, made to matter in Germany.
cases.body: The 2 Series Coupé was designed with the US market in mind. In Germany, it needed a reason to exist. We found it in its most loved ancestor, the BMW 2002 — and let the fans finish the campaign.
cases.challenge: The international launch introduced the 2 Series Coupé as a new model for a new audience, with the US as its main market. German drivers didn't need a new car so much as a reason to care about this one.
cases.idea: Don't launch a new car — continue a legend. In Germany, the 2 Series Coupé became the heir to the BMW 2002, one of the brand's most loved classics, turning a US-led product into a car for BMW enthusiasts. Then we handed the story to them: under the line „2 Worte für den BMW 2er“, fans shaped the campaign with their own words and designs.
did: Adapted the international campaign for the German market
Art direction for the heritage-led route
Co-creation mechanic and fan-generated executions
TV, Online, Print, CRM
result: A US-led product repositioned as a car for German BMW fans
A campaign ultimately made by its audience
[Numbers]

cases.title: Trust needs consistency.
cases.body: t-online was one of Germany's biggest news sites — yet many people still saw it as Telekom's homepage. We repositioned it as an independent journalistic brand, with a new identity, a new voice and a sound of its own.
cases.de: „Jeder hat ein Recht zu erfahren, was auf der Welt passiert. Verstanden statt nur informiert."
cases.en: "Everyone has the right to know what's happening in the world. Understood, not just informed."
cases.outcome: Independent editorial positioning, clearly set apart from Bild.de and WEB.DE
cases.challenge: t-online had the reach and the newsroom, but its origin as Deutsche Telekom's portal still shaped how people saw it. The brand needed to be seen as what it had become: independent, credible journalism.
cases.idea: Build the brand around the value of understanding, not just information.
cases.didLabel: What I did (client side, Ströer Content Group)
steps: Led the marketing narrative with external freelancers
Media mix for all marketing activities
Developed project proposals, secured internal approval and planned delivery within approved project budgets and internal media allocations.
Briefed and coordinated external creative partners and internal teams, aligning the work with C-level stakeholders.
New corporate design with in-house resources
OOH, Spotify, social media, print and trade fair
Steering and monitoring of media delivery
result: A more editorial identity with its own visual language and tone of voice
Clear differentiation from Bild.de and WEB.DE
Ranked #2 on r/munich, among other subreddits, in its launch week
Free earned reach: a six-minute discussion of the campaign on the tech podcast Doppelgänger
Shared by entrepreneur and investor Frank Thelen

cases.title: Sporty and efficient — told with a wink.
cases.body: The BMW 1 Series is popular with a young audience. The film promotes the two things that matter to them in one car: the sporty, typically BMW way of driving and the efficiency they expect today — with humour instead of spec sheets.
cases.outcome: „Fahrerlebnisschalter Sportmodus“ became a lasting social media metaphor in German-speaking countries
did: Idea development for the TVC
result: The campaign worked — and the term outlived it. „Fahrerlebnisschalter Sportmodus“ (EN: “driving experience switch, sport mode”) became a fixed social media metaphor in German-speaking countries
User-generated short videos on TikTok and Instagram — memes about switching older 1 Series models into sport mode — still reach seven-figure view counts today
59,241 new BMW 1 Series registrations in Germany in 2012, up 12 % on 2011 (KBA)

cases.title: Health that feels close.
cases.body: A brand campaign for AOK Baden-Württemberg built around one idea: GESUNDNAH — health close to people, in the moments they need it. Across media and channels, the platform highlighted AOK’s services: digital consultation, health offers, family support, the GP programme and the customer centres.
cases.de: „Da, wo du uns brauchst. Das ist GESUNDNAH.“
cases.en: “Right where you need us. That’s GESUNDNAH.”
cases.outcome: One brand platform for five AOK services, across all channels
did: Campaign concept for the AOK Baden-Württemberg brand campaign GESUNDNAH
Art direction across media and channels
One system for five AOK services: digital consultation, health offers, family support, GP programme, customer centres
result: A single brand platform that turns five individual health services into one recognisable promise

cases.title: More than numbers.
cases.body: A brand campaign that moved Union Investment from purely rational messaging to emotionally driven storytelling — without losing credibility.
cases.en: "Even the smallest number can make a big difference."
cases.role: Creative concept, campaign strategy, art direction
cases.outcome: A more human brand in one of the most rational categories
cases.challenge: Financial communication is built on facts, performance and rational decisions. The task was an emotional connection that keeps credibility intact.
cases.idea: Replace product-centric communication with a universal family story about love, conflict and reconciliation — the first financial institution in Germany to use the emotional significance of Christmas for its brand.
did: Creative concept
Campaign strategy
Integrated campaign
Art direction
result: Introduced a more human dimension to the Union Investment brand
Showed that emotional storytelling can build trust in a rational category

Brand campaign and integrated communication

Digital assets

Rolled out across additional European markets — Yelp's first pan-European TV campaign

cases.title: Making technology feel easy to ask about.
cases.body: One character, one promise. We turned Tech-Nick into a campaign platform that carried Saturn across every channel — on half the media budget of its biggest competitor.
cases.role: Art Director, lead of the art team
cases.outcome: Spontaneous awareness 80 % above target. GWA Effie case.
cases.challenge: Electronics retail is loud, price-driven and full of jargon. Saturn needed a brand voice that could handle a year of weekly retail pressure without losing recognition — against competitors with twice the media spend.
cases.idea: Put a human face on technical expertise. Tech-Nick, played by Antoine Monot, answered the questions customers were too embarrassed to ask.
steps: Creative platform based on the brand strategy
OOH, film, flyers, digital and social media
Supervision of shoots and film production
Year-round quality assurance of all outgoing Saturn media
Concepts for all thematic campaigns under the campaign umbrella
result: Spontaneous brand awareness 80 % above target
89 % aided awareness for Tech-Nick
"Conveys passion for technology": 50.4 %, ahead of Amazon and the leading competitor
Average basket value +10.2 % to €59.49 — on half the media budget of the largest competitor

cases.title: Jobs shown as they really are.
cases.body: One of Germany's largest employers needed an employer brand that felt consistent across hundreds of job profiles, audiences and channels — and honest enough to be believed.
cases.de: „Du willst beruflich die ‚digitale Schiene' – privat die sicherste."
cases.en: "At work, you want the digital track. In life, the safest one."
cases.role: Senior Art Director, lead of the art team
cases.outcome: A cohesive employer brand across TV, OOH, content and career films
cases.challenge: Create a stronger, more consistent employer brand experience across a wide range of target groups, channels and formats, while supporting the long-term development of the Deutsche Bahn employer brand.
cases.idea: Let the jobs speak for themselves — real roles, shown as honestly as possible, within one consistent visual and verbal system. An extensive audience analysis showed that apprentices need to be addressed very differently. So we created a dedicated design variant for them: related to the employer brand, but more dynamic and younger.
steps: Translated the strategy into a creative brief
Briefing and alignment with the creative team
Selling to and advising the client
Production lead through to final delivery
result: A more cohesive employer brand built on consistent visual and communicative principles, supporting recruitment and long-term brand perception
cases.ctxText: Deutsche Bahn hired more than 20,000 employees in 2020.
cases.quote: "The goal is to bring these jobs to life and present them as honestly as possible."
cases.quoteBy: Kerstin Wagner, Head of Talent Acquisition, Deutsche Bahn
